pages.text: Energy Cells store Chi Energy in bulk, capacity grows with tier (large numbers are shown with M/B/T suffixes):$(br)$(li)Basic: 500M (500 million)$(br)$(li)Advanced: 2B (2 billion)$(br)$(li)Super: 20B (20 billion)$(br)Right-click to inspect the stored energy; connect pipes to charge and discharge.
Upgrade an Advanced Cell with Compressed Chishi Essence Blocks to craft the Super Cell.
